name: Spec Extractor
description: Engine for catalog sites that publish their own specs: fetches manufacturer pages and manual PDFs politely (robots.txt, per-host rate limit, conditional requests, Amazon refused), extracts specs with deterministic per-brand extractors (a batched cheap-model fallback and a budgeted strong-model conflict adjudication, both off unless the site enables them), writes one provenance row per value plus typed spec rows and a spec status per model, then rebuilds compatibility edges (framework.core.compat_graph) and runtime estimates. Every phase short-circuits on unchanged input. Every table, column, kind and brand comes from the site's site.yaml; the niche lives in the spec-sources and compat-graph storage profiles. Per-site instances are config-only directories in the site repos.

metadata.llm: optional: cheap-model fallback (spec_sources llm.enabled, CLAUDE_POOL_RESERVE=2) and strong-model adjudication (adjudication.enabled, <= 0.1 h/day)
